title: 4 Trick Questions That Fool Almost Everyone #shorts #brainteaser
label: QUESTION
description:
Don't overthink it. Most people get number 4 wrong.

#riddles #brainteaser #quiz #shorts

questions.q: A rooster lays an egg on top of a roof. Which way does it roll?
Some months have 31 days. How many have 28?
A plane crashes right on the border of two countries. Where do they bury the survivors?
In a race, you pass the person in 2nd place. What place are you in now?
questions.why: You took their spot, not first.

outro: How many did you get? Comment your score.
